sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5
sources.evidence: Announcement dated November 24, 2025 says Opus 4.5 is available that day and identifies claude-opus-4-5-20251101; describes coding, reasoning and agentic use. Reopened October 27, 2026: token-efficiency comparisons and the effort setting supply neither a nominal model size nor a named, sized base model.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact dated ID and alias; November 24, 2025 release; 200K context, 64K output, extended thinking and text/image input to text output. Reopened October 27, 2026: the current specifications still label this model Active (legacy), with no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh 153-page official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:49 UTC and independently searched and read from the shared primary-source cache. Page 8 identifies Anthropic; pages 8-10 describe pretraining, post-training and effort as control over generated tokens. Section 6.5 pages 89-90 describes scratchpad experiments starting from the Opus 4.5 base model, without a size for that base. SAE feature activations and the page 153 tool-schema Parameters heading are not model counts. No nominal total or active count or named sized predecessor is supplied. Section 2.12 reports actual multi-step MCP tool use.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 Anthropic research explains Transformer residual streams and layers in Methods and explicitly includes Opus 4.5 among studied models, with exact-model intervention experiments. It does not disclose dense versus MoE topology or parameter counts; layer positions are normalized percentages. Reopened October 27, 2026: the Jacobian-lens matrices, J-space sparsity and layer-ablation experiments do not supply a nominal total/active parameter count or a sized predecessor.

sources.title: PDF support - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, using vision for text, charts and images. Combined with the exact model page marking Opus 4.5 active (legacy), supports the catalog PDF input capability.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used only as Claude distribution-policy evidence, not as exact-model technical evidence.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Anthropic API access is governed by commercial service terms with use restrictions and retained intellectual property rights, supporting the descriptive proprietary classification rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official 213-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:49 UTC and independently searched and read from the shared primary-source cache. Page 18 Table 2.3.A explicitly compares Opus 4.5 benchmark scores; its rows are evaluations, with no total or activated-parameter column. Training and interpretability sections discuss post-training, effort, SAE features and activation oracles without disclosing an Opus 4.5 parameter count or a sized lineage.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48 UTC and independently searched and read from the shared primary-source cache. Section 1.1 describes the newer model training process; full-text checks for Opus 4.5, model size, total/active/activated parameters and billion/trillion counts found no Opus 4.5 nominal size or sized lineage. No sibling specification is transferred.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full October 7, 2026 PDF retrieved and searched for parameter counts, model size and Opus 4.5. No Opus 4.5 size disclosure found; no sibling specification transferred.

sources.title: Models overview - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Explains the Models API line field and specifically states that Opus 4.5 belongs to the opus line, supporting the normalized claude-opus family.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Opus 4.5 Summary Table
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 after fresh focused first-party searches for Opus 4.5 parameter counts, active parameters, billion parameters and named-base lineage. The exact-model summary table lists release, access, modalities, hardware/frameworks, training and evaluations. Its architecture/training row says Opus 4.5 was pretrained and then post-trained/fine-tuned; it neither names a differently sized base nor gives nominal total or active counts. No qualifying count was found in the focused searches.

name.note: Exact product name and dated API ID match the frozen record.

developer.note: Original system card page 8 explicitly identifies the developer.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family label matches the documented opus model line.

release_date.note: Launch announcement and exact model documentation explicitly give this public release date; the ID suffix 20251101 is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Exact model has hosted platform availability; first-party Claude distribution policy expressly says model weights are not publicly released.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a Claude service under proprietary commercial terms; no open-weight license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit found no developer-published nominal total in the exact card, live specifications, Transparency Hub, interpretability research or later Opus cards. Post-training and experiments on the Opus 4.5 base model do not identify a base with a disclosed size. This null reflects missing nominal disclosure, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately on October 27: no nominal per-token active count or activated-parameter comparison column was found. Effort controls generated tokens, and SAE/J-lens activity measures representations rather than parameter counts. No active count is inferred from total size or an unestablished dense/MoE topology.

architecture.note: Methods describe Transformer residual-stream computation and explicitly include Opus 4.5 experiments. Supports the broad architecture only; does not establish dense/MoE structure or a physical layer count.

context_window.note: Exact public API model specification is 200K tokens. Larger internal evaluation configurations in the card do not establish a larger public context limit.

modalities.note: Exact model page specifies text and image input with text output. PDF is a supported API document input format through text/vision processing, not an independent neural modality.

reasoning.note: Extended thinking is optional, explicitly described for this exact model in section 1.1.2.

tool_call.note: Function calls are expressly included in the effort interface; section 2.12 evaluates Opus 4.5 on multi-step MCP tool invocation.

description.value: Claude Opus model for reasoning, coding and agentic tool use, with optional extended thinking.

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by Anthropic interpretability research that explicitly studies Opus 4.5. Anthropic does not disclose a nominal total or active parameter count in the checked sources or identify a sized base from which either can be inferred; dense/MoE topology is also undisclosed. PDF denotes an API document input format processed through text and vision.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains undisclosed total and active counts after reopening the exact system card, launch, live specifications and interpretability paper, checking later Opus 4.6 and 5.5 cards, and following fresh first-party searches to the Transparency Hub. No nominal count, active-count table or named sized lineage was found. Explicit null parameter patches and fresh evidence were added; all other audited field assessments are preserved.
